verses.1: I tell you the truth in Christ; I do not lie. This is because my conscience is guided by the Holy Spirit within me.
verses.2: For I feel great sorrow and endless pain in my heart.
verses.3: For I am indeed a debtor to Christ for my brothers and relatives in this world.
verses.4: They are those who belong to Israel. Their circumcision, their glory, their laws, their worship, and their prophecies all belong to them.
verses.5: By whom the fathers were born, and from whom Christ came, who was incarnated in the flesh, becoming a god worthy of praise for all time. Amen.
verses.6: But it’s not just that the word of God was spoken. Not all those from Israel were true Israelites; those who were not, they weren’t considered true Israelites at all.
verses.7: Not only is there Abraham’s seed among them, but also all his descendants. But it was Ishmael who was called your seed.
verses.8: It is this way: it’s not the offspring of the flesh that are considered to be the offspring of God. Instead, it’s the offspring of the Word that is considered to be the offspring of God.
verses.9: For this is the message of this speech: At the right time, I will be sent here, and I will become a son of Sarrha.
verses.10: Not only that, but also Rhabecca had a single eye. She was the daughter of our father.
verses.11: For surely, no good or evil thing can be born from those who are not rulers. Only the will of God, as chosen by God’s election, can prevail.
verses.12: Not from working, but from being kind and gentle, she realized that the greater worker would be the one who deserves to be treated with kindness.
verses.13: As it is written: I loved Jacob, but I treated Esau with indifference.
verses.14: So, what should we do? Should we not be unjust toward God? It hasn’t happened yet.
verses.15: To Moses, he said, “I will bless whom I will bless, and I will curse whom I will curse.”
verses.16: Therefore, it wasn’t the will of those who wanted to do so, nor the actions of those who rushed forward, but rather the obedience to God.
verses.17: For the text written by Pharao says that in this way, I will be able to show you my power within you. And in this way, my name will be known throughout all places.
verses.18: So, he will treat those whom he wants to be treated well with kindness, and those whom he wants to be treated harshly with severity.
verses.19: So, what questions do you have for me? Who exactly was involved in his decision-making process?
verses.20: Oh man, do you even realize who the one who will face God is? Don’t you understand that the creature created by God is nothing but a mere shadow? What have I done to deserve such a fate?
verses.21: Doesn’t the potter have the right to create objects from the clay he makes, either for decoration or for other purposes?
verses.22: But if God wants to show His wrath and demonstrate His power, then He will use many instruments of wrath that have been prepared for destruction.
verses.23: And so that he might realize the wealth of his fame through the instruments of charity, which he had prepared for this purpose.
verses.24: Just as he called us by that name, not only among the Jews, but also among other nations.
verses.25: Just as it is said in the hymn: “I call my people my people, and those who are not loved by me, I still love them.”
verses.26: And it will be in that place where they will be called by their names. Do not be like the people of my people; there, they will be called sons of God who live forever.
verses.27: Esaías cries out for Israel’s sake. If the number of the children of Israel is like the sand on the sea, then they will be saved from destruction.
verses.28: For it is the Lord who will create and bring about everything on earth.
verses.29: And when Esau was asked, “If not, Lord, then you must give us seed. Otherwise, we will become like Sodom and Gomorrah.”
verses.30: So what should we call it? It’s the justice that comes from those nations that do not seek justice themselves. Justice that comes from faith.
verses.31: But Israel, while striving for justice and law, did not actually achieve it.
verses.32: Why? Because it wasn’t done out of faith, but rather as a result of actions. They attached the stone to the surface.
verses.33: As it is written: “I see a stone placed in the midst of the sand, along with a rock that is scattered around it.” And those who believe in it will not be condemned.
